_comment: All driving dimensions in mm unless noted. Edit, then re-run ./build.sh to regenerate every output. Drives are goBILDA Stingray-4 (AZ) and Stingray-9 (EL) servo gearboxes, dimensions fixed in gimbal/parts.py from vendor/ STEP files.
_stingray_note: base_h and puck_z0 are 19 mm taller than v6 so the Stingray-4 (51 mm tall) fits under the deck
_arms_note: arm_thick = round column diameter, arm_wall its wall; shoulder_r = radius of the shoulder drums (cap = half-circle), shoulder_drop = how far the lower half's straight sides run below the axis before its half-circle (the Stingray-9 hangs 70 mm below the axis: drop + shoulder_r must be >= 80), shoulder_wall = shell thickness
_retainer_note: v10: retainer split into halves A (+Y) and B (-Y) that slide in under the seated drum; retainer_lap = half-length of the lap notches on the X axis, retainer_lap_lower = thickness of A's lower tongue, notch bolts at radius retainer_joint_r (outside the 216 mm drum so a key reaches them), +-retainer_joint_dy apart
_size_note: v9: pedestal/drum 216, foot flange and flange plate 236, puck 191 (bore 192), columns 60, shoulders 120 wide x 140 tall hollow shells; every part has >= 6 mm of margin on a 256 mm bed
